A 14-MINUTE URDU SHORT DRAMA

01The Full Drama

One morning. Told twice.

“Four lives crossed in one morning, reminding us that every heart deserves respect.”

Set in the heart of a busy Pakistani city, RESPECT: Everyone Deserves It follows four people from different walks of life, connected by one ordinary morning. As disrespect passes from one person to another, the same day unfolds again with a different choice and kindness. A story of human dignity, perspective, and the power of respect, brought to life through AI-generated drama by OG’s Production.

RESPECT: Everyone Deserves ItOFFICIAL THUMBNAIL · 14:00
WATCH NOW
Open in YouTube↗

02Synopsis

In a Pakistani city, a Boss under pressure scolds his Employee. The Employee snaps at the Peon. The Peon grows impatient with the Chaiwala over a single cup of chai. Unkindness travels down the ladder until it ends in silence at a roadside stall.

Then the same morning begins again. Same office, same file, same deadline. This time respect is passed on. Nobody’s class, job or position changes. Only their behaviour does.

03The Story

CHAPTER 01

Opening

A black screen carries the drama’s message in English and Urdu: respect is not defined by status, and how we treat one person can become how they treat another.

BOSSEMPLOYEEPEONCHAIWALA
CHAPTER 02

Part One · Four Lives

The city wakes up. Sadiq opens his shutter and serves his first customer. Mushtaq puts on his uniform and opens the office. Malik Junaid Khan wakes to a stream of notifications. Saad Ahmed rushes to a file whose deadline is close.

BOSSEMPLOYEEPEONCHAIWALA
CHAPTER 03

Part Two · What We Pass On

The Boss scolds Saad and will not hear him out. Frustrated, Saad snaps at Mushtaq. After work, Mushtaq grows impatient with Sadiq over a single cup of tea, and the Chaiwala silently watches him leave.

BOSSEMPLOYEEPEONCHAIWALA
CHAPTER 04

The Rewind

A black screen asks: what if respect was passed on instead? The same morning begins again.

BOSSEMPLOYEEPEONCHAIWALA
CHAPTER 05

Part Three · The Other Way

Same office, same file, same problem. This time the Boss stays calm and asks Saad to find a way. Saad thanks Mushtaq, and Mushtaq says “please” and “shukriya” to the Chaiwala, who blesses him with “khush raho”.

BOSSEMPLOYEEPEONCHAIWALA
CHAPTER 06

Ending

Four small smiles. Nobody’s life has become perfect; nobody’s class or position has changed. Only their behaviour has. The camera pulls out to the whole city: four different lives, one city.

BOSSEMPLOYEEPEONCHAIWALA

STORY INSIGHTS

Beyond the Story.

Every story has a meaning. This one asks us to reconsider how we treat others.

01 — CENTRAL IDEA

Respect should never depend on social status.

Every individual deserves dignity, whether they are a boss, an employee, a peon, or a chaiwala.

BossEmployeePeonChaiwala
02 — THE MORAL

Treat others the way you wish to be treated.

Small acts of kindness can make a meaningful difference. Never let position or power determine how you treat another person.

03 — KEY THEMES
Human DignitySocial EqualityEmpathyKindnessRespectPerspective
04 — STORYTELLING APPROACH
Reality OneRudeness passed down
Reality TwoRespect passed on

One Morning. Two Different Realities.

The same four people experience the same day in two different ways. Their social positions remain unchanged, but their behaviour transforms the meaning of every interaction.

05 — AUDIENCE TAKEAWAY

Your position defines your role.

Your behaviour defines your character.

AI-Assisted Filmmaking

Where human creativity meets artificial intelligence.

A written screenplay was brought to life through AI-generated visuals, with four consistent characters and recurring locations across two versions of the same day. Urdu voice performances, original music, and bilingual title cards complete the cinematic experience.

WORK-FLOW

The Creative Journey

From Initial to Final Screen

STAGE 01

Script Writing

Where the story takes shape: from a one-line idea to a scene-by-scene screenplay with Urdu dialogue.

GeminiExplores the idea, story structure and first scene drafts.
ClaudeRefines the screenplay, dialogue and shot-by-shot direction.
01
STAGE 02

Character Generation

Four faces, designed once and reused everywhere, so each person looks identical in both versions of the day.

GPTCreates the first character concepts and reference looks, and also the video thumbnail.
NB
Nano-BananaKeeps faces, outfits and expressions consistent across the character sheets and storyboard frames.
02
STAGE 03

Video Generation

Every scene prompt and reference frame becomes a moving, cinematic 1080p shot.

Flow
Google FlowGenerates the shots for all eleven scenes, using the same references for both versions of the day.
03
STAGE 04

Urdu Voice-over

Four distinct voices, so the Boss, Employee, Peon and Chaiwala each sound like themselves.

C
Cartesia AIGenerates natural Urdu dialogue with controlled pace and tone.
ElevenLabsAdds expressive, emotional delivery to each character’s voice.
04
STAGE 05

Music Generation

Sound that shifts the mood: ambient tone, soft piano, a warm build and a resolving finale.

Suno AIComposes the soft ambient and piano themes.
M
Mureka AIGenerates the warm building music and the resolving finale.
05
STAGE 06

Video Editing

Shots, voices and music come together into one finished fourteen-minute drama.

CapCutAssembles the rough cut, subtitles and bilingual title cards.
Pr
Premiere ProHandles the final cut, the colour grade from cool to warm, and the audio mix.
